correctness.rationale: From λ≡3 mod4, B=(1−λ)+8Z2 consists of v2(x)=1 and f² maps B into itself. For x,y∈B, f²(x)−f²(y)=(x−y)(x+y)(x²+y²−2λ), where x+y divisible by 4 and the third factor has v2=1, giving contraction ≥3 valuation gains per two iterations; Banach gives unique β, α=f(β) odd. Every odd x maps into B in one step, even in two. For u=y−β with k=v2(u)≥3, f(y)−α=u(2β+u) has v2=k+2; expansion f²(β+u)−β=u[4αβ+(6β²−2λ)u+4βu²+u³] has leading bracket valuation exactly3 and all others >3, proving k+3 per even iteration by induction. The h_N depth formula handles even/odd offsets; global branch exceptions for already-on-cycle and immediate one-step hits give the genuinely least T_N. Independent direct iteration through all residues mod 2^N (N=1..11) for λ=3,7,11,15,19,23 returned 24,564 exact agreement checks. Analytic valuation proof covers all Z2 parameters; finite experiments alone do not.
residual_risks: Contraction and exact coefficient valuation require λ≡3 mod4 and B as defined.
No claims about λ outside the congruence class or quotient preperiod histograms.
